description: This PHP source file defines a controller class 'Cheque' for the OpenCart e-commerce platform. The class handles the display and processing of settings for the cheque payment extension in the admin area, including loading language strings, configuration settings, and views, as well as saving configuration changes via AJAX.

classes.name: Opencart\Admin\Controller\Extension\Opencart\Payment\Cheque
classes.description: Controller class for admin payment cheque settings in OpenCart platform

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles display of the cheque payment extension settings page, loading language strings, configuration, and generating the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the AJAX request to save the cheque payment settings, performing permission checks and validation before updating the configuration.
